subject: Reapply causal edges without downgrading blocking dependencies
description: Rework the causal task_result edge implementation from the prior kicked-back attempt. Preserve structured task_result.causal_edges validation/schema/docs and graph-store metadata persistence, but fix the bug where applyCausalEdges calls overlayStore.addEdge(kind:'context') and can convert an existing blocking edge with the same from/to pair into context. Add a regression test proving an existing blocking dependency remains blocking when a causal edge with the same endpoints is reported; still record causal evidence in a non-blocking/relation-aware way. Run node test/causal-task-result.test.js, node test/handoff-validation.test.js, node test/graph-store-edge-meta.test.js, and git diff --check.

Verified causal/handoff/graph-store/weighted-edge tests plus blocking-dep context seed/native adoption checks and diff-check.
